i.norm: Tests that {@link FileUtils#lineIterator(File, String)} rejects an unknown charset name, rather than silently opening the file with some default.
JUnit-managed temporary directory, cleaned up automatically after the test.
Given: a real file written with a valid encoding.
When/Then: requesting a line iterator with an unknown charset name fails fast.
Builds three sample lines ("LINE 0", "LINE 1", "LINE 2"). The exact content is irrelevant to this test; the file only needs to exist with valid contents.
